documents.title: Employee Handbook
documents.text: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave requests must be submitted in the HR portal and approved by the employee's manager. Unused leave cannot be carried into the next calendar year. The probation period for new employees is six months. Employees must notify their manager before 9 AM when taking unplanned sick leave.

documents.title: Remote Work Policy
documents.text: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Tuesday is the required company-wide office day. Remote work outside the employee's home country requires written approval from People Operations and Information Security. Employees must use the company VPN when accessing internal systems from public networks.

documents.title: Business Expense Policy
documents.text: Meal expenses during approved business travel are reimbursed up to 2500 INR per day. Expense reports and itemized receipts must be submitted within 30 days after travel ends. Director approval is required for airfare upgrades. Personal entertainment and minibar purchases are not reimbursable.

documents.title: Information Security Policy
documents.text: Suspected phishing messages must be reported to security@example.com using the Report Phishing button. Employees must not forward suspicious attachments. Company passwords require at least 14 characters and multi-factor authentication. Lost company devices must be reported to the security team within one hour.

documents.title: Employee Benefits Guide
documents.text: The company provides medical insurance for employees, spouses, and up to two dependent children. New dependents must be enrolled within 30 days of a qualifying life event. The annual wellness allowance is 15000 INR. Employees may use the wellness allowance for gym memberships, fitness classes, or mental health applications.

documents.title: Parental Leave Policy
documents.text: Primary caregivers receive 20 weeks of paid parental leave. Secondary caregivers receive 8 weeks of paid leave. Parental leave may begin up to two weeks before the expected birth or adoption date. Employees should notify People Operations at least 60 days before planned leave when possible.

documents.title: Learning and Development Policy
documents.text: Each employee receives an annual learning budget of 40000 INR. The budget may be used for courses, professional certifications, technical books, and conferences. Manager approval is required before purchase. Travel costs for conferences require separate approval and do not come from the learning budget.

documents.title: Company Equipment Policy
documents.text: Employees may replace their company laptop after four years. Standard equipment includes one laptop, one monitor, a keyboard, and a mouse. Equipment remains company property and must be returned within seven days after employment ends. Repairs must be arranged through the IT help desk.

documents.title: Code of Conduct
documents.text: Employees must disclose actual or potential conflicts of interest to the Legal team. Gifts from vendors valued above 5000 INR require written approval. Harassment or discrimination may be reported confidentially through the ethics hotline. Retaliation against anyone who makes a good-faith report is prohibited.

documents.title: Corporate Travel Policy
documents.text: Domestic flights under six hours must be booked in economy class. Hotels are limited to 10000 INR per night unless the destination has an approved exception. Business travel must be booked through the corporate travel portal. Travelers may extend a trip for personal reasons but must pay all additional costs.
